main.summary: Implements cross-family writer conflict lookups by scanning segmented and stream staged manifests under the configured storage roots.

field.name: segmentedStorage
field.summary: Segmented transfer staging storage used to resolve the configured root directory for segmented manifest scans.

field.name: streamStorage
field.summary: Stream transfer staging storage used to resolve the configured root directory for stream manifest scans.

method.name: FindSegmentedOpenConflictByItemId
method.summary: Locate the most relevant segmented upload session that blocks opening a new writer for the specified item.
method.returns: Segmented writer conflict when one exists.

method.name: FindStreamOpenConflictByItemId
method.summary: Locate the most relevant stream source session that blocks opening a new writer for the specified item.
method.returns: Stream writer conflict when one exists.

method.name: BlocksWriterOpen
method.summary: Determine whether a transfer mode and status combination should block opening a new writer session.
method.returns: True when the existing session should block a new writer open.
